info.name: LedgerOne - Accounting (Chart of Accounts)
info.description:
Accounting module (Account Group, Account) API collection — Chart of Accounts (00_BUSINESS_RULES.md Ch.17-18). Covers Create/Get/Update/List for both entities plus Account's Activate/Deactivate lifecycle. Reflects the implementation exactly as shipped in apps/api/src/shared/accounting.

Design note (both entities are tenant-owned, mirroring Tax Group/Tax Rule): Account Group (00_BUSINESS_RULES.md Ch.18.13/Ch.17.13's "Company Administrator approval" implies Company-level configuration) and Account (mirrors its parent Account Group's ownership) both require X-Tenant-Id on every request — unlike Currency's platform-owned no-header posture.

Design note (hierarchy/type-consistency): AGP-003 (a child Account Group's accountType must equal its parent Account Group's — ACC_ACCOUNT_GROUP_TYPE_MISMATCH), AGP-002 (an Account's accountType must equal its own Account Group's — ACC_ACCOUNT_GROUP_ASSIGNMENT_TYPE_MISMATCH), and COA-002 (an Account's accountType must equal its parent Account's — ACC_ACCOUNT_TYPE_MISMATCH) are three distinct error codes exercised separately in this collection, each isolated from the other two by construction (e.g. the COA-002 test uses an Account/Account Group pair that already satisfies AGP-002, so only COA-002 can fail). Hierarchy-cycle detection (an Account Group/Account whose ancestor chain loops back on itself) is a known, intentionally-deferred gap — not tested here, per explicit instruction.

Design note (repeatable naming/codes): Account Group name is unique per Company (Ch.18.13-inferred, mirroring Tax Group's uq_tax_groups_tenant_company_name_deleted_at) with no delete endpoint, and Account code is a never-reused identity per Company even after deactivation (00_BUSINESS_RULES.md Ch.17.7 COA-004 — the strictest uniqueness rule of any Accounting entity so far, since it has no deletedAt escape hatch at all). A collection-level pre-request script derives a numeric {{coaSuffix}} (from the current timestamp) for both Account Group names and Account codes, once per Newman invocation — a distinct variable name from Tax.postman_collection.json's own {{txSuffix}}, so the two collections' pre-request scripts never collide when both run against the same shared environment/database. Test data is still deleted directly via SQL after a verification pass, matching every other Accounting collection's established cleanup convention.

Design note (lifecycle): Account's Draft -> Active -> Inactive lifecycle (00_BUSINESS_RULES.md Ch.17.5) mirrors Currency's own activate/deactivate posture; the final 'Deactivate Account - Rejects Already-Inactive' request confirms the illegal Inactive -> Inactive transition is rejected with ACC_INVALID_ACCOUNT_STATUS_TRANSITION (409). Account Group has no lifecycle at all (Ch.18.5 — "largely static"), mirroring Tax Group.

Run order for a full pass, top to bottom: the entire Account Group folder before the Account folder — {{accountGroupUuid}}/{{secondAccountGroupUuid}}/{{childAccountGroupUuid}} must all be set (by the Account Group folder's own Create requests) before any Account request runs, since a valid Account needs a real Account Group's uuid.
